decisions.decision: Adi only needs to supply the two WhatsApp group invite links. The agent does the rest now. (1) Write the 5-minute Day 0 welcome script to COPY_RULES (Backlinko voice, no dashes). Produce it as an AI-avatar video from Adi's Kie.ai avatar poses in ~/tantra-content/content/brand/people/adi/avatars (ai-avatar-only-rule). Publish it on our own Cloudflare or GitHub mirror and set welcome_url in revops-centre Admin, Cohort Settings with centre_admin.py. Adi reviews it in T-484 as finished work. (2) When Adi replies with the invite links, set announce_url and cohort_url. The agent then makes the QR PNG(s) itself from cohort_url, adds them to the deck and Day 0 cards, and redeploys. (3) Until then the cards keep showing 'Invite link arrives before Day 1'. Update T-484 evidence and close T-491 once the links are set.
decisions.why: DECISIONS_FOR_ADI item 19 and d0a.md: the agent can set the links. No group links exist in any session or the corpus (searched). The QR comes from the URL. The video can follow ai-avatar-only-rule (2026-10-22). Only the WhatsApp groups need Adi's phone.
